# **Outtalent now helps iOS developers get jobs abroad at companies like Apple and Google**


## Applications are open until June 15th


[Ana Ghidelli](https://medium.com/@anaghidelli?source=post_page---byline--15b25d3260cb---------------------------------------)


1 min read


·


May 28, 2021


--


Press enter or click to view image in full size


When we started Outtalent, our goal was to help back-end engineers get jobs at companies like Google. After 2 years of running the program and having analyzed thousands of applications, we couldn’t help but notice an increasing number of great iOS applicants.


Therefore, when the time came for us to explore growth opportunities, choosing to start the expansion with an iOS track was natural. Plus, even without a formal iOS track, we have already helped one iOS developer get a job at Facebook.


**We couldn’t be more excited to formally launch the iOS track.**


During the last few months, we worked hard to build a strong course outline that would help prepare developers for interviews with amazing companies. We also brought in new mentors who are current iOS engineers at Google and Apple, who are also invested in helping our iOS fellows get great jobs abroad.


If you know any iOS developers from Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Moldova, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, or Uzbekistan, please share this announcement with them.


**Last day to apply: June 15th**
You can check your eligibility here:[https://outtalent.com/check](https://outtalent.com/check)
